records.observation:
Complete529-line javap in consecutive1–270/271–529 slices. Extends JTree; constructor passes supplied DefaultMutableTreeNode to superclass, retains same tree_root, sets JTree.lineStyle Angled. No custom model/expansion/selection listeners registered, no model-replacement override or buffer initialization. init explicitly update_leveled_paths then editable=true; before renew buffer listnull and buf_level default0.
getNamedVtr(path) captures last DefaultMutableTreeNode.toString as new named_vector name. Only when path NOT expanded recursively visits CHILDREN: leaf child adds actual userObject; nonleaf child recurses. Expanded path returns empty named vector, selected leaf also empty because no children; not a singleton of selected leaf. Descendant traversal includes all leaves regardless individual visibility/search/category flags, no dedup/copy of payloads/null guards.
update_leveled_paths sets max_level from tree_root.getLastLeaf().getLevel(), NOT maximum depth over all leaves. Allocates ArrayList[max_level+1], index0 capacity1/rest default, breadth-first traverses all nodes, builds TreePaths from actual node.getPath and indexes by node.getLevel. An irregular tree with a deeper nonlast leaf can overflow the allocated level array; normal balanced map construction not assumed broken before YaxisMaps read. Retained root may diverge from later inherited setModel/root changes. No checks for detached/nonlevel0 root.
Expansion cursor scan starts boolean allExpanded=true and i0; scans each level while i<max_level and boolean true, conjunction of JTree.isExpanded over paths, stops inner loop at first false but increments i after processed level. Finally next_expanding_level = max_level if i>max_level else i-1. Hence first notfullyexpanded level k yields k; if every tested level0..max-1 expanded, cursor max-1 (not max); max_level0 yields -1. isLevelExpandable simply cursor<max; expandLevel guard then indexes leveled_paths[cursor], expands collapsed paths, increments cursor if <max (else setsmax). Thus root-only max0→cursor-1 passes expandable then negative array index possible. No lower-bound guard or recalc after inherited individual expand/collapse. isLevelCollapsable tests cursor-1>=0; collapseLevel guarded, collapses expanded paths at cursor-1 then sets cursor to that level. These methods themselves have guards, resolving previous action receipt: actions lack check but delegates enforce these cursor-based predicates. No redraw/Commit/map calls here.
renewCutAndPasteBuffer FIRST buf_level=-1 then clear existing list or createArrayList. isCutAndPasteBufferUniformlyLeveled null/empty returnsTRUE WITHOUT setting level; nonempty uses current last node.getLevel, compares every node, mismatch false with unchangedlevel, allsame storesfirstlevel. Depth is actual node ancestry, not TreePath component count, not same parent. No root/self-target/dedup/attachment/model-membership checks; same-depth selection cannot include distinct ancestor+descendant in an intact tree. isPathLevelSameAsThatOfCutAndPasteBuffer compares storedlevel to current targetnodelevel only. addToBuffer does nothing if listnull; otherwise appends supplied pathrefs in input order, duplicates allowed, no level check/update and nullarray unchecked. getFromBuffer returnsNULL when uninitialized; otherwise builds fresh TreePath[] via intermediateObject[] retaining path/node identities. clearBuffer empties only, preserves buf_level.
Connection to Mark: renew clears OLD valid selection before mixed-level selection fails; Mark remains enabled after success, so remarking mixed depths leaves empty buffer while prior Move/Delete button enablement is untouched. Subsequent Move warns empty; Delete asks confirmation then warns empty. Successful root-only Mark depth0 is allowed; removal cannot safely assume parent. Target being one marked same-level node is admitted by depth check, confirming Move can detach target before parent.getIndex(target)+1 calculation (ordinary DefaultMutableTreeNode returns-1 then base0). These are static call-chain observations, no GUI execution. Normal Mark ensures list exists before Delete, so direct Delete null dereference is not claimed inevitable UI behavior.
update_leveled_paths only builds paths/cursor; no custom listener or explicit canvas synchronization in this class. Combined Move/Delete normal tail still has no explicit Commit call; standard Swing/model events remain external behavior, so no broad claim that any redraw never occurs. Archived classes not executed or independently approved.
